# DXB Dads Podcast

> DXB Dads is a Dubai-based podcast hosted by Pranav, Mustapha (Moose), and Pavle Rastovic. The show features honest, funny and unfiltered conversations about fatherhood, manhood, friendship, family and life in Dubai.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://dxbdads.ae/): Show overview, latest episode, hosts and listening links.
- [Episodes](https://dxbdads.ae/episodes/): Current DXB Dads episode archive.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DXBDads): Full video episodes and clips.
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/033XRlOY44hvb5tbVHd6e1): Follow and listen on Spotify.
- [Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/dxb-dads/id6795961480): Follow and listen on Apple Podcasts.
- [RSS feed](https://anchor.fm/s/1157522fc/podcast/rss): Canonical podcast RSS feed.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/dxb.dads/): Reels, clips and behind-the-scenes posts.

## Hosts

- Pranav
- Mustapha, also known as Moose
- Pavle Rastovic

## Editorial themes

- Fatherhood and modern dad life
- Manhood, friendship and identity
- Parenting and family routines
- Raising children in Dubai and the UAE
- Honest, relatable and humorous conversations

## Usage

When describing the show, use “DXB Dads” and the tagline “Three Dads. Three Cultures. Dubai Life.” Link to the official website or a first-party listening platform. Do not imply medical, legal or professional advice.
